footer.disclaimer: Opportunistic™ ibalaselisa kuluhlu lomntu wesithathu kwaye ayingomniki walo naluphi na uhlobo lokufunda okanye umsebenzi. Qinisekisa imihla ebekiweyo kunye nokufaneleka kwisiza somthombo. Sisebenzisa isiseko semfihlo se-GDPR kwihlabathi jikelele; Ikhukhi kunye nezixhobo zohlalutyo zilayisha kuphela ngemvume yakho.

settings.privacyCookiesBody: Lawula iikuki ozikhethelayo nangaliphi na ixesha. Iikuki eziyimfuneko zihlala zivuliwe ukuze ukhuseleke kwaye ukhumbule olu khetho.
settings.dangerBody: Ukucima iakhawunti kususa iprofayile yakho, iziqinisekiso, izakhono kunye nomdlalo (i-cascade).

howItWorks.title: Yondla inkqubo. Fumana imidlalo ekuluhlu.
howItWorks.lede: Cofa inqanaba ngalinye okanye ubukele umjikelo we-console: ngenisa idatha yeprofayile, imibuzo yenkqubo, iziphumo eziqiqayo.
howItWorks.cadenceBody: Ukutshatisa kuqhuba ekudalweni kweprofayile, xa uhlela iziqinisekiso, izakhono, okanye ilizwe, kunye neshedyuli yeveki - hayi kutyelelo ngalunye lwedeshibhodi.
howItWorks.trustBody: Sibeka uluhlu oluvela kwiibhodi zokwenyani kunye neeportal. Soloko uqinisekisa imihla emisiweyo kwisiza somthombo. Ixesha elibekiweyo elidlulileyo liyahluzwa kwideshibhodi yakho.
howItWorks.ctaBody: Yenza iakhawunti kwaye ugqibezele ukukhwela ukwenza umdlalo wakho wokuqala.

features.title: Abadlali ababini. Iprofayile enye.
features.lede: Scholarships ehlabathini lonke. Imisebenzi ngokwelizwe. Amanqaku kunye nezizathu zihlala ekhadini.
features.scholarshipBody: Izidanga zakho kunye nezakhono ziqhuba uphando. Ikhadi ngalinye le-scholarship libonisa amanqaku + kutheni kufanelekile.
features.jobBody: Iprofayili efanayo, injini yesibini. Imisebenzi iyalihlonipha ilizwe olikhethileyo - ngamanqaku afanelekileyo acacileyo.
features.profileBody: Ilizwe → ngawe → iziqinisekiso → izakhono. Ukuhlela kamva kuphinda kufane ngokuzenzekelayo.
features.privacyBody: Ukucinywa kwenqanaba le-GDPR kumntu wonke. Ukususwa kweprofayili cascades ukuya kwizakhono, izakhono, kunye nomdlalo.
features.gridReasonBody: Kutheni umdlalo ngamnye ulingana uhlala ekhadini - hayi emva kwemodali.
features.gridMobileBody: Uninzi lwabafaki-zicelo lufika ngefowuni; uyilo kunye nesindululo siyayihlonipha loo nto.
features.ctaBody: Tsibela kwi-animated walkthrough, okanye uqale ukwakha iprofayile yakho.

about.title: Ukufundiswa kwezifundo kunye nemisebenzi, ehambelana nezizathu.
about.lede: Yakhelwe abantu abadinwe kukuskrola iibhodi zegeneric. Faka into oyifundileyo kunye nento onokuyenza - sibeka iindawo zokuvula kwaye sitsho ukuba kutheni zifanelekile.
about.ideaTitle: Ukuthelekisa kufuneka kuvakale njengengcaciso emfutshane, hayi indawo yokulahla amakhonkco.
about.ideaBody1: Iinjini zokukhangela kunye neebhodi zamathuba zibonisa umthamo. Abafane bazi isidanga sakho seNzululwazi yeKhompyutha, izakhono zakho zeReact, okanye ukuba ufaka isicelo eBotswana-kwaye phantse abakhe bachaze ukufaneleka.
about.ideaBody2: Opportunistic igcina iprofayili enye ephilayo kwaye iqhuba i-scholarship kunye nomsebenzi ohambelana nayo. Zonke iziphumo ziphethe amanqaku, umthombo, kunye nesizathu onokusisebenzisa ngokwenene.
about.p1Body: Izidanga, izakhono, kunye nelizwe ngumthombo wenyaniso. Iimidlalo ziyakha kwakhona xa uzitshintsha.
about.p2Body: Amanqaku ngaphandle kwengcaciso yingxolo. Sibhala ukuba kutheni uluhlu lungena - ngolwimi olucacileyo.
about.p3Body: Sifumanisa kwaye sibeka umgangatho. Ufaka isicelo kwi-scholarship esemthethweni okanye indawo yomqeshi.
about.areItem2: Iingcebiso ze-Playbook ezizodwa kwizakhono zakho kunye neenjongo
about.areItem3: Gcina, gxotha, kwaye uphinde udibanise xa iprofayile yakho itshintsha
about.notItem1: Asiniki mali yokufunda okanye siqeshe nabani na
about.notItem3: Soloko uqinisekisa imihla ebekiweyo kuluhlu olusemthethweni
about.studioBody: Opportunistic™ yimveliso yoYilo lweFuturify — eyilelwe ukuba uzive ichanekile, izolile, kwaye iluncedo, hayi njengenye ibhodi yetemplate.
about.ctaBody: Yenza i-akhawunti, qinisekisa izakhono kwidigri yakho, kwaye uvule iimatshisi ezikumgangatho kunye nezizathu.

match.gone: Lomdlalo awusafumaneki. Isenokuba ihlaziywe emva kohlaziyo lweprofayile.
match.emptyBody: Buyela kwideshibhodi kwaye uvule umdlalo wangoku. Ukugcina iprofayile yakho kwakha iziphumo kwidatha yakho yamva nje.
match.playbookNote: Iingcebiso ezizodwa ezakhiwe kwiprofayile yakho, izakhono, kunye nolu luhlu. Ziyahlaziya xa uhlela iprofayile yakho - okanye ucofe iingcebiso ezintsha.
match.eligibilityNote: Hlala uqinisekisa imithetho yamva nje kumthombo osemthethweni - iinkqubo zitshintsha ngomjikelo kunye nobuzwe.
match.reasonFallback: Vula uluhlu lwemithombo kwaye uthelekise iimfuno kwiprofayile yakho.

terms.title: Imimmiselo yokusebenzisa
terms.lede: Imigaqo yokusebenzisa Opportunistic njengomaleko wokufunyanwa - hayi njengomkhuphi walo naliphi na ithuba.

privacyBody.overview: Opportunistic ("thina") sibonelela nge-scholarship kunye nokuhambelana nomsebenzi. Lo mgaqo-nkqubo ucacisa ukuba siqokelela ntoni, kutheni, siyigcina ixesha elingakanani, kunye namalungelo akho. Sisebenzisa isiseko somgangatho we-GDPR kumsebenzisi ngamnye kwihlabathi jikelele, kwaye siyayihlonipha imithetho engqongqo yasekhaya apho isebenza khona (kuquka i-UK GDPR, iPOPIA yaseMzantsi Afrika, kunye nezikhokelo ezifanayo). Esi sisikhokelo esisebenzayo sokuthobela imveliso yethu - hayi ingcebiso esemthethweni yomthetho kwindawo yakho.
privacyBody.lawfulContractDesc: Ukwenza iakhawunti yakho, ukuthelekisa, kunye nokuhambisa inkonzo oyicelayo
privacyBody.lawfulLegitimateDesc: Ukhuseleko, uthintelo lwempatho-gadalala, ukuthembeka kwenkonzo - ulungelelwaniso ngokuchasene namalungelo akho
privacyBody.lawfulLegalDesc: Apho kufuneka sigcine okanye siveze idatha phantsi komthetho osebenzayo
privacyBody.storeAccountDesc: Imeyile kunye nenkcazi yobungqina ngeSupabase Auth
privacyBody.storeProfileDesc: Igama, ilizwe, isihloko, bio, iziqinisekiso, kunye nezakhono ozifakayo
privacyBody.storeMatchesDesc: Isihloko, i-URL, umthombo, ukucinga, amanqaku, kunye nokugcina/chasa urhulumente
privacyBody.storeTechnicalDesc: I-cookie yemvume, iikuki zeseshoni ezifunekayo ukuze ungene, uhlalutyo olukhethwayo ukuba uyazivumela
privacyBody.cookiesIntro: Sisebenzisa icookie yemvume (opp_consent) ukukhumbula ukhetho lwakho ukuya kutsho kwiinyanga ezili-12. Iikuki eziyimfuneko zigcina ungqinisiso lukhuselekile. Ezikhethwayo, uhlalutyo, kunye neekuki zentengiso zilayisha kuphela emva kokuba ungenile. Ungatshintsha ingqondo yakho nangaliphi na ixesha.
privacyBody.cookiesNecessaryDesc: Iseshoni yoBubhali, ukhuseleko, ukugcina le mvume
privacyBody.cookiesAnalyticsDesc: Umlinganiselo wosetyenziso — izikripthi zivaliwe de zivunyelwe
privacyBody.cookiesMarketingDesc: Iithegi zentengiso / ukuthengisa kwakhona — imibhalo ivaliwe de ivunyelwe
privacyBody.cookiesOrFooter: — okanye usebenzise useto lweCookie kwindawo esezantsi.
privacyBody.useBody: Iprofayile yakho inamandla ahambelanayo kunye neengcebiso ezinengqiqo. Asithengisi idatha yomntu. Asizisebenzisi iziqinisekiso zakho ukwakha iiprofayile zentengiso ngaphandle kokuba uvumela ngokucacileyo iikuki zentengiso kunye neqabane lentengiso lexesha elizayo lidizwe apha.
privacyBody.transfersBody: I-Infrastructure inokusebenza idatha kwimimandla esetyenziswa ngababoneleli bethu (umzekelo iSupabase kunye neBrevo). Apho idatha ishiya ilizwe lakho, sixhomekeke kukhuseleko olufanelekileyo olwamkelwa phantsi kwemithetho yesimbo se-GDPR (efana namagatya ekhontrakthi aqhelekileyo anikezelwa ngabo baboneleli) kwaye sinciphise oko sikugcinayo.
privacyBody.retentionBody: Ukuhlala kwe-akhawunti kunye nomdlalo wedatha ngelixa i-akhawunti yakho isebenza. Ukuba ucima idatha yakho kwiiSetingi, sisusa iprofayile, iziqinisekiso, izakhono, iimidlalo, kunye nembali yokukhangela kwiziko ledatha leapp. Ukucocwa kweakhawunti ye-Auth-akhawunti kunokucelwa apha hello@opportunistic.online. Iirekhodi zemvume zinokugcinwa njengobungqina bokhetho ukuya kuthi ga kubomi be-cookie okanye njengoko kufunwa ngumthetho.
privacyBody.rightsBody: Ngokuxhomekeke kwindawo ohlala kuyo, unokuba namalungelo okufikelela, ukulungisa, ukucima, ukunqanda, into, i-port data, kunye nokurhoxisa imvume. Siyazihlonipha ezi zinto njengesiseko sehlabathi. Ungayihlela iprofayile yakho nangaliphi na ixesha kwaye ucime idatha yakho kwiiSetingi.
privacyBody.childrenBody: Opportunistic ayibhekiswa kubantwana abangaphantsi kweminyaka eyi-16 (okanye ubudala bemvume yedijithali kwilizwe lakho). Musa ukwenza i-akhawunti ukuba ungaphantsi kwaloo minyaka. Ukuba sifunda ukuba sibambe idatha enjalo, siya kuyicima.
privacyBody.sharingBody: Sabelana ngedatha kunye nabaqhubekekisi abancedisa ukuqhuba inkonzo: i-Supabase (i-auth/database), i-Brevo (i-imeyile yetransaction xa ivuliwe), kunye nokusingatha (i-our hosting providers). Uluhlu luvulwa kwiziza zomntu wesithathu ezinemigaqo-nkqubo yazo. Asithengisi idatha yomntu.

termsBody.roleBody: Opportunistic liqonga lokufumanisa. Sijonga i-scholarship yomntu wesithathu kunye noluhlu lwemisebenzi ngokusekelwe kwiprofayile yakho. Asingomniki, umqeshi, okanye umnikezeli walo naliphi na ithuba eliboniswe kwisiza.
termsBody.roleCallout: Soloko ugqibezela izicelo kuluhlu olusemthethweni lomthombo. Opportunistic ichaza kufanelekile; umthombo ungumnikazi wokufaneleka kunye neziphumo.
termsBody.accuracyBody: Uluhlu lunokuphelelwa lixesha emva kokufakwa kwesalathiso. Soloko uqinisekisa ukufaneleka, imihla ebekiweyo, kunye namanyathelo okufaka isicelo kwiwebhusayithi yomthombo ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo. Amanqaku omdlalo, ukuqiqa, kunye neengcebiso ziyingcebiso - ayizoziqinisekiso zokwamkelwa, inkxaso-mali, okanye ingqesho.
termsBody.accountOthersDesc: Musa ukulayisha idatha yomnye umntu ngaphandle kwemvume
termsBody.accountFairDesc: Sinokuzirhoxisa ii-akhawunti ezihambelana kakubi okanye sizame ukukrazula inkonzo
termsBody.liabilityBody: Ngowona mlinganiselo ugcweleyo uvunyelwe ngumthetho, Opportunistic akanaxanduva lwezigqibo ezenziweyo ngokusekelwe kuluhlu oluphandle, kubandakanywa amathuba avaliweyo, umxholo ongachanekanga womntu wesithathu, okanye izicelo ezingaphumelelanga.
termsBody.privacyAfter: icacisa into esiyiqokelelayo kunye namalungelo akho. Iikuki ezikhethwayo kunye nobuchwepheshe obufanayo bulayisha kuphela emva kokuba uvumile usebenzisa ibhena yecookie okanye useto lweCookie. Iikuki eziyimfuneko zokhuseleko, ukungena, kunye nokukhumbula ukuba ukhetho luhlala luvuliwe. 'Yabona
termsBody.changesBody: Sinokuyihlaziya le migaqo njengoko imveliso ikhula. Umhla ohlaziyiweyo phezulu kweli phepha ubonisa uhlaziyo lwamva nje. Ukusetyenziswa okuqhubekayo emva kweenguqu kuthetha ukuba uyayamkela imimiselo ehlaziyiweyo.

tips.sAdvanced: Khokela ngobunzulu bakho {{skill}} ({{level}}) njengobungqina onokuthi ukwazi ukububamba {{intensity}} ubunzulu.
tips.sWeak: Ngaphambi kokuhambisa, phakamisa {{skill}} ngeprojekthi emfutshane okanye isatifikethi - ababuyekezi baqaphela amabango ezakhono ezingagqitywanga.
tips.sRefereeInst: Buza usompempe ku-{{institution}} obone ukuba ukhokele, akakufundisi kuphela - Iiphaneli zesitayile seChevening zinempembelelo kumabakala kuphela.
tips.sRefereeGeneric: Khusela oosompempe ababini abanokuthi bacaphule inyathelo elithile olenzileyo - iileta ezingacacanga "zomfundi osebenza nzima" zitshonisa iiprofayili ezinamandla.
tips.sCalendar: Yakha umhla wokugqibela wekhalenda ukusuka ku-“{{deadline}}” enezithinteli zokushicilelweyo, iimvavanyo, kunye neereferensi.
tips.sOffline: Iimpendulo eziqulunqiweyo zingekho kwi-intanethi kuqala, emva koko uncamathisele kwi-portal - ugcino-lwazi oluzenzekelayo lucima iiyure zokusebenza kwiifomu ezininzi zokufunda.
tips.sAlumni: Uphando lwaba-2 alumni abavela {{place}} abaphumelele {{source}}; Qaphela ukuba izicelo zabo zigxininise ntoni kwaye ujonge isakhiwo, hayi ibali.
tips.sScore: Ukuba amanqaku akho omdlalo {{score}}%, phatha izikhewu ngokunyanisekileyo kwisincoko - iiphaneli zivuza ukuzazi ngaphezu kwamabango omfezeko.
tips.sHeadline: Lungelelanisa isihloko sakho (“{{headline}}”) kunye nothumo lwenkqubo oluchaziweyo ukuze isikrini sokuqala sele siziva sinenjongo.
tips.sPitch: Lungiselela imizuzwana engama-60 yelizwi lelizwi lesicwangciso sakho sodliwano-ndlebe: ingxaki → isiphelo sakho → {{source}} njenge-accelerator.
tips.sProof: Qokelela ubungqina bezinto zakudala (i-GitHub, iingxelo, amabhaso, iileta zasekuhlaleni) ezibuyisela zonke izakhono ozidwelisileyo-izikrini zilungile ngaphambi kokuba ufake isicelo.
tips.sEligibility: Jonga ubuzwe kunye namagatya okubuyela ekhaya {{source}} ngokuchasene nemeko yakho {{country}} kulo mjikelo — iimpazamo zokufaneleka zimosha izincoko ezinamandla.
tips.sBio: Phinda ubhale i-bio yakho ukuze umntu ongamaziyo {{location}} aqonde indawo yakho kwisivakalisi esinye, emva koko wandise.
tips.sCheveningCourses: Khetha iikhosi ezintathu zase-UK ezifanelekileyo ngokunyanisekileyo {{field}}, hayi udumo lodwa - I-Chevening iyala ii-trios zekhosi ezingahambelaniyo kunye nezincoko ezinamandla.
tips.sCheveningNet: Chitha iphepha elipheleleyo kwizicwangciso "zothungelwano": yeyiphi imibutho yase-UK, iilebhu, okanye amaqela omgaqo-nkqubo oya kujoyina, kunye nento oyibuyisela kuyo {{place}}.
tips.sDaadFilter: Hlunga i-DAAD ngokwenqanaba ledigri yakho kanye {{field}}, emva koko uluhlu olufutshane lweefowuni ezi-2 - izicelo eziqhelekileyo ze-"Jamani" azifane zicacise ukusika kokuqala.
tips.sDaadLang: Gqiba kwangethuba ukuba ufuna ubungqina baseJamani okanye besiNgesi benkqubo yokusingatha, kwaye ubhukishe umhla wovavanyo phambi kokuba umnxeba uvalwe.
tips.sMastercardApply: Faka isicelo kwiyunivesiti esebenzisana nayo efundisa {{field}} - Izifundiswa ze-Mastercard zingqale kwikhampasi, hayi enye indlela yehlabathi.
tips.sMastercardNeed: Bhala imfuno kunye nobunkokeli kunye: umhlathi omnye kwimiqobo, omnye malunga noko sele ukutshintshile kwabanye {{place}}.
tips.sFulbrightPage: Sebenzisa iphepha lelizwe lakho leFulbright kuphela - imihla ebekiweyo kunye neefom ze-{{country}} zahlukile kwincwadana yehlabathi.
tips.sFulbrightObj: Yenza injongo yophando/yofundo ibe yinkohliso: ngowuphi umbuzo kwi-{{field}} oya kuwuphendula kwiinyanga ezili-12–24?
tips.sGates: Ukufaneleka kweCambridge kuza kuqala: chaza umphathi okanye iqela lelebhu ehambelana {{field}} phambi kokupholisha ingxelo yeGates.
tips.sTheme: Bopha isindululo sakho kumxholo opapashiweyo osuka ku-{{source}}, usebenzisa ulwimi olusuka kumnxeba — ulungelelwaniso olungalunganga lwesihloko kukwaliwa okuthe cwaka okuqhelekileyo.
tips.jResume: Phinda ubhale isishwankathelo sakho seCV yakho ukuze ukhokele ngokuthi {{skill}} + {{field}}, emva koko ujonge izenzi ezi-5 eziphezulu kwisishwankathelo ngasinye {{source}} ekukuvulileyo.
tips.jProof: Yakha i-1-page "proof sheet" ngeebhulethi ezi-3: ingxaki, isenzo usebenzisa {{skills}}, iziphumo ezinokulinganiswa.
tips.jAdvanced: Beka {{skills}} kwisithathu sokuqala se-LinkedIn / Malunga - abaqeshwa bayaskim, abazingeli.
tips.jWeak: Ngeendima ezifuna {{skill}}, yongeza iprojekthi encinci yempelaveki kwaye uyidibanise - amabango aphakathi ngaphandle kobungqina ayahluzwa.
tips.jAlerts: Seta {{source}} izilumkiso ze "{{field}}" kunye nelizwe lakho ({{country}}), uze ufake isicelo kwiiyure ze-48 zokuthumela.
tips.jTarget: Ithagethi yeenkampani ezi-5 ngeveki eziqeshayo {{field}} ngaphakathi okanye ukusuka {{country}}, hayi i-50 random Easy Faka ucofa ucofa.
tips.jCover: Kwinqaku ngalinye lekhava, chaza ikhonkrithi enye onokuthi uyithumele kwiintsuku ezingama-30 zokuqala usebenzisa isitaki sakho sangoku.
tips.jReferrals: Cela ukuthunyelwa kuphela emva kokuba unokuchaza imveliso yeqela kwizivakalisi ezi-2 - kubanda kubuza ngaphandle kokutshisa iibhulorho zomsebenzi wasekhaya.
tips.jLoom: Rekhoda i-Loom yemizuzwana engama-90 (okanye inqaku lelizwi) uhamba ngeprojekthi; yiqhoboshele xa {{source}} ivumela umyalezo/ufaka ezongezelelweyo.
tips.jConfidence: Ukuzithemba kwakho komdlalo ngu ~{{score}}% - ukuba ngaphantsi kwe-70%, qinisa izakhono kwiProfayili kwaye uphinde udibanise phambi kokutshiza izicelo.
tips.jTranslate: Guqulela ulwimi lwezifundo ukusuka {{field}} ukuya kulwimi lomqeshi: “umsebenzi wezifundo” → “zinise u-X phantsi kwexesha elimiselweyo”.
tips.jLog: Gcina umbhalo wokuchasa: indima, isakhono esilahlekileyo, isenzo esilandelayo - iipateni zikuxelela ukuba ufunde ntoni ngokulandelayo ngokukhawuleza kunoqikelelo.
tips.jLinkedinOpen: Layita Vula kuMsebenzi (abaqeshwa kuphela) kwaye ucinezele iprojekthi ephawulweyo engqina {{skill}}.
tips.jLinkedinComment: Phawula ngokucingisisayo ngezithuba ezi-3 zomphathi oqeshisayo {{field}} kule veki phambi kokuba uqalise ukusebenza - ukubonakala okufudumeleyo kubethe cwaka Faka isicelo.
tips.jIndeed: Sebenzisa isihluzi sendawo ye-Inene njenge "{{country}}" kwaye uhlele ngokomhla - i-stale reposts inkunkuma yamandla.
tips.jRemoteOk: Funda ilizwe/umgca wexesha lendawo kabini kwizithuba zeRemote OK — ezininzi iindima “ezikude” zisangabandakanyi {{country}}.
tips.jRemoteRate: Ixabiso lereyithi yekontraka yakho kunye nexesha elithe kratya kumyalezo wokuqala ukunqanda isiporho emva kwezikrini.
tips.jGlassdoor: Funda iingxelo zodliwano-ndlebe zamva nje zaloo mqeshi, emva koko ulungiselele amabali ama-2 aphendula eyona patheni yombuzo ophindaphindiweyo.
tips.jReliefImpact: Izicelo ezikhokelayo ezinempembelelo ebaleni/yevolontiya {{place}} — I-ReliefWeb iqesha iiweights kakhulu ngamava afanelekileyo.
tips.jReliefLang: Tshatisa ulwimi olusuka kwisithuba ( ISIDLO, ukukhuselwa, UKUHLAMBA, njl. njl.) kuphela ukuba unokusikhusela — ukufakwa kwe-buzzword kuyabonakala.
tips.jHeadline: Ngqamanisa isihloko sakho sikawonke-wonke ku-“{{headline}}” kuyo yonke indawo ofaka kuyo isicelo ukuze {{source}} izikrini kunye ne-CV yakho zibalise ibali elinye.
